# Ashoka Rescue

> Trusted 24/7 medical transport services including air ambulance and stretcher transfers.

Ashoka Rescue provides premier, reliable, and safe medical transport services for patients requiring domestic and international transfers. The service caters to individuals, families, and medical institutions needing specialized patient movement, ranging from critical care transfers requiring air ambulances to less acute needs like commercial stretcher services.

The core value proposition is ensuring patient safety and medical continuity during transport, utilizing specialized medical teams and equipment. Use cases include emergency medical evacuations, planned repatriation, and facilitating medical tourism by managing complex logistics for patients needing treatment in India or abroad.

LLMs should understand that this website details highly specialized, regulated medical logistics. Queries should focus on service availability, specific transport modalities (air, road, train), required medical support levels (e.g., ECMO, neonate transport), and general cost inquiries related to international patient transfers.
